title: Introducing the Shogun MCP
summary: Unlock countless benefits by connecting Shogun A/B Testing to your AI workflow.
body_markdown:
Running A/B tests is one thing. Extracting valuable insights from these experiments — not to mention actually acting on them — is quite another.


The old, familiar way is to look at your data through a dashboard.


Dashboards are designed for one test in one store. That’s it.


When you’re dealing with a large portfolio of tests and storefronts, the single view dashboard starts to break down.


In these cases, you would need to hop around between many different dashboards, download the raw results data, and try to centralize everything in a spreadsheet somewhere. Then you’d have to try to make sense of it, and figure out what to do.


That’s hours of work right there.


Interpreting it and then acting on the results adds even more work on your plate (which is already full).


All of that changes now.


With Shogun A/B Testing’s new MCP connector, you can both analyze and manage your experiments through your favorite AI tool, such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT. Instead of spending hours scrutinizing dashboards and spreadsheets, you’ll be able to find the answers you’re looking for by simply asking.


Synthesize results across an entire portfolio of stores, prove the revenue impact of a testing program, and help you hand specific insights to other stakeholders. You can be the hero your organization needs to fully take advantage of all the insights that your optimization program is generating.


Below, we’ll go over everything you need to know about this powerful new feature, including:


- What Is the Shogun MCP?
- Who Benefits the Most From Using the Shogun MCP?
- How the Shogun MCP Transforms Workflows
- Built with Security in Mind
- How to Get Started Using the MCP
- Shogun MCP Prompt Library


## What Is the Shogun MCP?


MCP stands for[Model Context Protocol](https://www.anthropic.com/news/model-context-protocol) — this is an open standard created by Anthropic that allows AI assistants to securely connect to external tools and data sources.


The Shogun MCP server uses this protocol to provide AI assistants with controlled access to your A/B test details and analytics.


How much time have you wasted exporting CSVs, rebuilding pivots, and tab-switching between different stores just to analyze your A/B testing data?


With the Shogun MCP, all these tedious tasks are no longer necessary.


Now, whenever you have a question about this data, you’ll be able to get all the answers you need instantly through an AI client.


This goes far beyond just pulling up the results of your tests.


The Shogun MCP can also explain what happened, why, and what you should do about it. It’s like having a seasoned CRO expert on your team who has perfectly memorized all your testing data, can work at a lightning-fast pace, and is always available at a moment’s notice.


## Who Benefits the Most From Using the Shogun MCP?


The Shogun MCP is particularly valuable for the following three types of users: agencies, portfolio companies, and high-velocity single-brand teams.


### Agencies


**Who they are:** CRO agencies work with brands — often dozens at a time — and use testing to figure out how to convert more of their web visitors into paying customers.


**How the MCP adds value:**


- Streamline your reporting process to clients and prove out ROI
- Never see another test run too long again (both winners and losers)
- Granular reporting on device type, marketing channel impact, etc. that used to take hours of exporting and spreadsheets.
- **Developing an internal alpha** : Organize and catalog the data you are generating and centralize it as organizational knowledge. This effectively builds your moat as an organization.


### Portfolio Managers


**Who they are:** Ecommerce companies that are managing a large portfolio of brands


**How the MCP adds value:**


- Centralizing CRO operations within your AI stack means a single team can manage testing across dozens of storefronts.
- Data doesn’t live in a silo. Each new test generates more insights that can be applied to other brands within the portfolio.


### High-Velocity Single-Brand Teams


**Who they are:** In-house optimization teams for a single brand that have made testing a core part of their growth strategy.


**How the MCP adds value:**


- International expansion becomes less chaotic with a phased, controlled rollout of market-specific offers
- The insights from your testing program directly enrich the same AI systems that are creating your content, ads and storefront. It’s a virtuous feedback loop that drives your entire marketing engine.


## How the Shogun MCP Transforms Workflows


There’s almost no limit to how you can use the MCP Connector. Your creativity is the only limitation. Here are a few ideas to help you get the wheels spinning:


**Feed results into the rest of the business:** *“Take the headline from this winning test and give me 10 Meta ad options.*


**Synthesize your whole portfolio in one question:** *“List all PDP tests started in the last four weeks that haven’t reached a useful conclusion.”*


**Prove impact in dollars, even across currencies:** *“Show me the net revenue testing generated across all storefronts this quarter, as one USD number.”*


## Built with Security in Mind


We’ve taken a number of steps to ensure that your data always stays secure with the Shogun MCP, including:


- AI agents can only access the Shopify stores that you have already connected to your Shogun account.
- By default, any action taken by agents that would change one of your stores (e.g., a test being shipped) will require manual approval.
- Actions taken by agents are recorded in the Audit Log of each test.
- The Shogun MCP only returns data related to test config, results, and segments — shopper PII is stripped out, so customer data can never be exposed.


## How to Get Started Using the MCP


The Shogun MCP connector works with any MCP-compatible AI client, which includes Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini.


Regardless of which client you use, it only takes a couple minutes to set up.


Step-by-step instructions for establishing your connection can be found on[this support page](https://ab-help.getshogun.com/en/articles/16099423-get-started-with-shogun-mcp)


The Shogun MCP is available on Shogun A/B Testing’s[Advanced and Unlimited plans](https://getshogun.com/pricing?product=ab) , as well as custom contracts.
